text: Set thine house in order: Heb. give charge concerning thy house
degress which is gone down in the sun dial: Heb. degrees by, or with the Sun
with a pining sickness: Or, From the thrum
undertake for me: Or, ease me
for peace I had great bitterness: Or, on my peace came great bitterness | thou hast in love to my soul delivered it from the pit: Heb. thou hast loved me from the pit
